title: Reliable Knowledge Acquisition for Continual Learning Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.21739v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As agents powered by foundation models move into open-ended environments, continual learning from experience becomes essential. For agents built on models with fixed parameters, this learning requires reusing prior task experience in context to improve performance and efficiency on future tasks. Existing memory and experience-learning systems typically focus on either retained facts or procedures, and lack a mechanism for establishing the reliability of claims extracted from the ongoing task stream. Indeed, we find that approximately 12--33\% of entries produced by representative systems harm future task performance when reused. translated_title: 面向持续学习智能体的可靠知识获取
translated_abstract: 随着由基础模型驱动的智能体进入开放式环境，从经验中进行持续学习变得至关重要。对于基于固定参数模型构建的智能体而言，这种学习需要在上下文中复用先前的任务经验，以提升未来任务的表现和效率。现有的记忆与经验学习系统通常只关注保留的事实或程序性内容，缺乏一种机制来确立从持续任务流中提取的论断的可靠性。事实上，我们发现代表性系统所产生的条目中约有12%–33%在被复用时反而会损害未来任务的表现。为解决这些局限，我们提出了RIKA（可靠知识获取，Reliable Knowledge Acquisition），该方法将事实性、概念性、程序性和元认知知识的分层提取与基于证据的知识准入机制相结合，利用来源证据和后续经验来控制哪些论断能够进入知识库……
tldr: 提出RIKA框架，通过分层提取事实、概念、程序和元认知四类知识，并引入基于来源证据与后续经验的证据准入机制，解决现有经验学习系统中12%–33%的条目会损害未来任务性能的知识可靠性问题。
en_tdlr: RIKA is proposed to solve the reliability problem—where 12–33% of entries from existing experience-learning systems harm future task performance—by combining hierarchical extraction of factual, conceptual, procedural, and metacognitive knowledge with evidence-based knowledge admission that leverages source evidence and subsequent experience.
